title: Florida Senate, District 36
what_it_does: Represents District 36 in the Florida Senate; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Florida Politics reports West Miami Democrat George Lavin filed the day before the June 2026 qualifying deadline, so incumbent Ileana Garcia (R) is no longer unopposed (https://floridapolitics.com/archives/801451-ileana-garcia-no-longer-unopposed-after-west-miami-democrat-george-lavin-files-to-run-in-sd-36/); Ballotpedia lists Garcia in the Aug. 18 Republican primary. Whether Lavin completed qualifying was not separately verified. Research limitation (Sept 2026): Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, dos.fl.gov, floridaelectionwatch.gov, Florida Politics and all news sites were blocked for fetching in this sandbox and the WebSearch budget was capped, so the roster is built only from search-result snippets; write-in/NPA qualifiers could not be checked. Positions are null because no snippet contained an explicit issue statement.

candidates.name: Ileana Garcia
candidates.photo_source: Florida Senate member page (portrait image URL not verified; site blocked in sandbox)
candidates.background: Garcia, a Miami Republican first elected to the Senate in 2020 and re-elected in SD 36 in 2022, is seeking another term; AIF listed her among its 2026 legislative endorsements.
